spanish: Y dijo Faraón: He aquí, mucho *es* ahora el pueblo de la tierra, y han hecho cesar a ellos de sus cargas.
grammarChanges: Marked the supplied copula in italics: *es*, since the clause on h02005005003/h02005005004/h02005005005/h02005005006/h02005005007 (הֵן רַבִּים עַתָּה עַם הָאָרֶץ) is verbless with no overt copula token.

Kept 'mucho' (singular) agreeing with the singular head noun 'pueblo' (h02005005006), since Spanish will not let pueblo take a plural adjective; the Hebrew plural adjective רַבִּים (h02005005004) on the singular construct עַם cannot be rendered as a plural Spanish adjective without breaking that agreement.
readerNote: *es* is a supplied copula with no corresponding Hebrew token, and 'mucho' stays singular to agree with the singular head noun pueblo, since Spanish cannot give pueblo a plural adjective to match the Hebrew plural force of רבים.
